notes.title: Astral Siege has just been released!
notes.content:
The second expansion for Tower Tactics: Liberation, [b]Astral Siege[/b], has just been released! I hope you all like it! ❤ It's much bigger than Celestial Dawn, both in content and the new game mode: Siege! Comes with:

[list]
[*] [b]1 new game mode: Siege![/b]

Build your card collection and keep your morale high to survive as many days as possible in the endless siege!

Buy card packs to grow your collection, build towers in the Crystal Mine to increase your income, visit the Sanctuary to restore your morale, and much more!

At the end of each day, you will face a combat in which after the last wave you'll have to open the gates to unleash an endless wave of enemies! You can close the gates at any time to stop more enemies from appearing, but if you do it too soon you'll lose health and morale! On the other hand, if you survive for more time than needed you'll receive a reward... but don't get too greedy, since even though enemies stop spawning after closing the gates, you still have to deal with the ones that are alive!

notes.title: v1.12
notes.content:
[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Endless Mode received changes, see below.[/b]
[*] Cards now play their draw animation when added to your hand through random effects. (e.g: Harvest Knowledge)
[/list]

[h1]Endless Mode changes[/h1]
Previous to this patch, the difficulty in Endless Mode scaled linearly, which made it easy to become practically invincible and keep playing infinitely with enemies dying almost instantly. Also, being able to stack trinkets infinitely made it a certainty that at some point, all players will experience performance issues, to the point of the game crashing when playing for too long.
To address these issues, this patch implements the following changes:

[list]
[*] [b]The Eternal Bane and Eternal Sorrow trinkets have been removed from the game.[/b] That means that elites will give trinkets again, and player heal effects will no longer have a chance to fail.
[*] [b]The difficulty in Endless Mode now scales exponentially.[/b]
[*] [b]Enemies now also grow their speed and their resistances against stuns, slows, and teleports on each loop[/b] (the maximum enemy speed has been set to 250)
[*] [b]The trinket limit is now 100.[/b] After obtaining 100 trinkets, the following trinkets you would gain disappear on pickup and give you a random stat boost instead. Whenever you have 90 trinkets or more and you hover over a trinket, a small text message appears indicating the number of trinkets you have and the limit.
[*] After the fifth loop, effects that deal damage based on the amount of health/max health enemies have can deal a maximum of 9999 damage.
[*] [b]A new Endless Mode indicator has been added to the top bar, that explains the current difficulty modifiers when hovered.[/b]
[*] [i]Additional changes might come in future patches such as limiting the game speed when the FPS drops too low while playing in a high endless loop. Reducing the game speed and enabling Low Performance Mode really help if you're experiencing performance issues![/i]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/19proH4.png[/img]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[h2]Cards[/h2]
[h3]Downshaper[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Level 1 enemies impacted now receive a slow instead of dying instantly.[/b]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FNMkMKc.png[/img]
[h3]Pursue Glory[/h3]
[list]
[*] [strike]Gain 5 shield. If you have 50 or more shield, end the combat.[/strike] >>> [b]Gain 5 shield. If you have 40 or more shield, level up three random towers.[/b]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0z63bqe.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed a crash involving the Mystery Box tower's effect triggering whenever there are no available tower slots left on the map.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.7.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Small patch today, bringing a requested change by increasing maximum game speed a bit, and some changes to improve performance in long survival runs! (in the Celestial Dawn DLC)

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]The maximum game speed is now x4 instead of x3.[/b]
[/list]

[h3][Celestial Dawn DLC] Survival Mode Difficulty Scalings[/h3]
Up until this patch, the way difficulty increased while playing survival was by steadily ramping up the number of spawned enemies as time progressed, especially after minute 18, since up until that point the scaling is mainly done through the enemies leveling up. 

In hindsight, I now see that was a mistake. The reasons are obvious, an infinitely scaling game mode with an infinitely increasing number of enemies spawning means worse performance as minutes go on, until the game can't handle that many enemies anymore and crashes. Rookie mistake, but let's fix that!

From this patch onwards the amount of enemies still increases over time, but once it reaches a limit (about 30-40 enemies at the same time on the screen, depending on the map), incoming enemy flow stabilizes and the scaling is now done mainly by increasing their health and resistances.

This change should drastically improve performance on deep, long survival games. I believe that it should no longer crash, no matter how long the game lasts.

notes.title: We're approaching the end of the early access! What's next?
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[b]Next patch will be version 1.0 of the game![/b] The current build (early access 1.38) will remain as the last patch of the early access phase of the game. 

This has been my first commercial game, and being able to consider it a complete success fills me with joy. Years of my life went into making it. I still haven't completely assimilated the fact of having made something that people from all over the world enjoy. 2022 was a year full of changes in my personal life, and it will be a year that I'll always remember.

[b]Ok, so what does this mean?[/b]

In short:
[list]
[b][*] The official release will happen a few days after the update drops, to catch any bug that may have arised.
[*] The game's price won't change.
[*] The game will still receive updates, just at a slower pace as I begin working on new projects.
[*] I hope to reveal the next project this year.
[*] I love you all![/b]
[/list]

Best Regards,
[b]AsraWorks[/b]

notes.title: early access 1.31.0
notes.content:
[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]A new mechanic has been added to the game, shields![/b] If you were to lose health during combat while having shields, you lose that amount of shields instead. You also lose a percentage of your total shields (by default it's 80%) after each wave.
[*] [b]There's now a wave preview before each wave![/b] You can now plan your strategy before the enemies start rolling in.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZbgCYEf.png[/img]


[*] [b]8 new cards have been added to the game![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fCRzilb.png[/img]

[*] [b]Towers now remember the last targeting priority you assigned to them.[/b] Also, the key to change target priorities has been changed to right click.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[h2]Regarding attrition[/h2]
Health attrition works differently in Tower Tactics: Liberation compared to other roguelike deckbuilders. In this game, it's very easy to recover health during combats, so hunting as most elites as possible is usually the best strategy, as it usually doesn't have many negative consequences. 
With the new Shields mechanic, we open up a lot of new design space, and making health regeneration effects rarer and a bit more costly will make them feel more special and will make each decision the player makes matter more.
[list]
[*] [b]Shields have been introduced to the game.[/b]
[*] [b]Almost all decks now start with more health and less health regen.[/b]
[*] [b]Some health regeneration effects have been reworked into giving shields, and some others have increased a bit in mana cost.[/b]
[*] More changes will come in the future regarding the remaining existing ways to regenerate health.

[/list]
[h2]Offerings[/h2]
[b]New offerings that reduce the amount of shields you lose after each wave have been added to the game![/b] Also, the luck offerings have been buffed:
[list]
[*] Common luck offering: +2 luck -> [b]+3 luck[/b]
[*] Uncommon luck offering: +3 luck -> [b]+4 luck[/b]
[*] Rare luck offering: +4 luck -> [b]+5 luck[/b]
[*] Mythic luck offering: +12 luck -> [b]+15 luck[/b]
[/list]


[h2]Cards[/h2]

[list]

[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Now gives 2 shield instead of 1 health.[/b]

[/list]
[*] [b]Medkit[/b]
[list]
[*] Mana cost: 3 -> [b]4[/b]
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: early access 1.30.0
notes.content:
[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]A new node has been added to the game, Hordes![/b] Hordes are special combats that challenge you to survive a big swarm of enemies for three minutes. [b]Dont forget to bring area damage towers to them![/b] The spacebar hotkey to toggle the game speed between the default and 0 comes in handy to stop and think your next move!
[*] [b]Two new card types have been added to the game, Curses and Emblems![/b] Curses are unplayable cards meant to punish very small decks and appear only in certain conditions and Emblems are also unplayable cards, but they give a passive effect as long as they are in your hand! [b]As such, 8 new cards have been added to the game![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9ZyPxOm.png[/img]
[*] [b]Some changes have been made to incentivize large decks.[/b] The addition of Curses is one of those changes, but there are more, you can see the full details below.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[h2]Incentivizing large decks[/h2]
As it stands right now, sometimes it's not worth it enough to pick many new cards because the starting decks are too consistent. This isn't too healthy for the game, so there have been some changes to alleviate this issue. More incentives are coming in future patches.
[list]
[*] [b]You now draw 5 cards each round by default instead of 4.[/b]
[*] The ascension 6 debuff has been changed from "+25% card and trinket cost in shops" to "you start with a curse in your deck".
[*] The "draw one fewer card each round" boss modifier has been changed to "add a curse to your deck during this combat"
[*] Almost all of the decks now start with more cards.
[*] The Transcend mechanic has been added, which rewards you for having 25 or more cards in your deck. More cards with Transcend will be added soon.

[/list]
[h2]EXP Gain[/h2]
If you're really good at the game, you should unlock new content much faster.
[list]
[*] Bonus EXP for each Ascension: +10% -> [b]+20%[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Luck Synthesis[/b]

[list]
[*] Mana cost: 8 -> [b]6[/b]
[*] Luck gained: 2 -> [b]3[/b]
[/list]
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: early access 1.29.0
notes.content:
[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]A new unlockable deck has been added to the game![/b] To unlock it, you have to reach level 40 and then win a game without healing! (the healing between sectors doesn't count) 

You can use any offerings and any ascension for this challenge! When reaching level 40, there will be a small indicator in the top bar while playing that will remind you of that objective, and if you're on track to complete it. (If you heal, the indicator will disappear).

[*] [b]Now cards can't draw themselves![/b] No more casting the same Foresee infinitely when it's the only card left in your draw pile and you have a way to obtain infinite mana. This change has opened some design space for some new cards!
[*] [b]Now cards and trinkets have a small fade in/out animation when showing their descriptions.[/b] Much easier on the eyes! 
[*] A toggle to display the level 3 tower art instead of the level 1 art in tower cards has been added to the Options menu!
[*] A toggle to enable or disable vsync has been added to the Options menu!
[*] Two trinkets have been added! Say hello to [b]Inflict Fear[/b] and [b]Predator Instinct[/b] (the trinket that the new deck starts with).
[*] Four new cards have been added! Say hello to [b]Night Crawler[/b], [b]Luck Synthesis[/b], [b]Reckless Search[/b] and [b]Divination[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GwwL93A.png[/img]

[*] Now you can search cards in every card list through their descriptions and not only through their title!
[*] A toggle that lets you filter basic cards have been added to card lists.
[*] Tower cards now have an additional icon that shows at a glance the damage type that tower deals.
[*] Basic cards now have a small indicator of their basic status on the bottom of the card.
[*] Many balance changes and bug fixes! Check them out below.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[b]All enemies now have an additional 5 speed for each level above 1 they have.[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]EMP Bomber[/b]

This enemy is too strong on its own compared to the others.

[list]
[*] Health: (75, 150, 300, 1200) -> [b](60, 120, 240, 960)[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Infiltrator[/b]

When you don't have any way to uncloak this enemy, waiting for it to go away can be painful due to its low speed. Also, it shouldn't be that tanky.

[list]
[*] Health: (100, 200, 400, 1600) -> [b](90, 180, 360, 1440)[/b]
[*] Armor: (8, 16, 32, 48) -> [b](0, 0, 0, 0)[/b]
[*] Magic Resist: (10, 20, 40, 60) -> [b](0, 0, 0, 0)[/b]
[*] Speed: (45, 45, 45, 45) -> [b](70, 75, 80, 85)[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Runner[/b]

Its high speed and tankiness can make these a bit unpredictable.

[list]
[*] Health: (55, 110, 220, 880) -> [b](50, 100, 200, 800)[/b]
[*] Speed: (105, 105, 105, 105) -> [b](100, 105, 110, 115)[/b]
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Forge[/h2]
[b]Usually when you buy stat upgrades in a forge the changes don't seem too meaningful. These buffs aim to alleviate that issue.[/b] The prices of the stats listed below have increased a small bit, but the changes are considered as big buffs overall.

[list]
[*] Max health earned when upgrading: 1 -> [b]2[/b]
[*] Luck earned when upgrading: 1 -> [b]2[/b]
[*] Fire rate multiplier earned when upgrading: 1% -> [b]3%[/b]
[*] Range multiplier earned when upgrading: 1% -> [b]3%[/b]
[*] Flat armor pen earned when upgrading: 3 -> [b]6[/b]
[*] Flat magic pen earned when upgrading: 3 -> [b]6[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Crystals earned[/h2]
[b]The crystals gained by default can make many shops, forges and events useless. Let's give you more crystals![/b]

[list]
[*] Crystals gained after each battle: [18, 26] -> [b][20, 30][/b]
[/list]

[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Overwhelming Support[/b]

As this card can win you the game by itself, you should have to struggle to cast it without the proper setup.

[list]
[*] Mana cost: 8 -> [b]9[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Avid Reading[/b]

Too easy to cast since the spell mana changes some patches ago.

[list]
[*] Mana cost: 3 -> [b]4[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Barricade[/b]

Lowering a bit the mana cost will make it a bit more flexible to cast, and that's something that this card needs quite a lot.

[list]
[*] Mana cost: 6 -> [b]5[/b]
[/list]
[*] [b]Mana Potion[/b]

No more infinite combos with Foresee. Also, making it dispel allows it to have a mana cost of 1, making it more useful in most scenarios.

[list]
[*] Mana cost: 2 -> [b]1[/b]
[*] [b]Now dispels.[/b]
[/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]#56[/b]: Increasing the max hand size too much will take too much space on the screen.
[*] [b]#64[/b]: The text of the first card sometimes runs over the mana counts.

notes.content:

notes.title: early access 1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Another huge patch full of goodies![/h1]

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]16 new trinkets! This is a 34% increase, considering we had 47 before![/b]
[*] [b]Brazilian Portuguese translation![/b]: This translation is in beta stage and may contain errors. As always, if you spot any let me know and they'll get fixed ASAP!
[*] [b]Complete music revamp![/b] Many new background tracks that complement the old ones creating a much better gameplay experience. I sincerely recommend playing with the music on.
[*] [b]Astral Dust progression mini-rework (details below).[/b]
[*] [b]Many small QoL updates (also detailed below)[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Astral Dust and offering changes[/h2]
[h3]These changes aim to reduce the need to disenchant offerings to create new ones, among many other things.[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Astral Dust gained for completing a sector has gone up approximately 50%! (when the player's level is low the buff is even stronger, closer to +100%)
[*] Common offerings now cost 100 astral dust to enchant, instead of 200.
[*] The buff to the astral dust you get when disenchanting offerings obtained at levels 7, 14, 21 and 28 increased from +25% each to +100% each
[*] The base astral dust you get for disenchanting offerings has changed to the following (remember that when you reach high levels, you get more astral dust than before due to the other changes in this patch):
[list]
[*] Common: 40 -> 20
[*] Uncommon: 80 -> 60
[*] Rare: 160 -> 120
[*] Mythic: 480 -> 360
[/list]
[*] Now there is a common max health offering.
[*] The mythic health regen offering now gives 2 regen instead of 1.
[*] The astral dust earned when you cannot receive a new offering because all the slots are full has increased from 40 to 200.
[/list]

[h2]Deck balance[/h2]
[b]Leading Legacy[/b]
[list]
[*] Max health: 12 -> 14
[*] Range & attack speed multipliers: 6% -> 9%
[*] Flat armor & magic pen: 6 -> 0
[/list]
[b]Wandering Colossus[/b]
[list]
[*] Max health: 15 -> 17
[/list]
[b]Resonating Echoes[/b]
[list]
[*] Flat magic pen: 5 -> 15
[/list]
[b]Early Bird[/b]
[list]
[*] Flat armor & magic pen: 12 -> 24
[/list]

[h2]QoL improvements and other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Maps now have backgrounds
[*] Improved the damage number animations (it makes a bigger difference than you might think)
[*] Ascension indicator in the top bar ingame
[*] Now the game remembers which ascension you last selected in each deck
[*] The boss modifier that disabled the first tower you placed has been removed
[*] Removed the early wave types that had Hijackers (so you'll start to face them in later waves)
[/list]

notes.title: early access 1.2
notes.content:
[h1]You thought last patch was big? Brace yourselves.[/h1]

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Portuguese and Polish translations[/b]: These translations are in beta stage and may contain errors. As always, if you spot any let me know and they'll get fixed ASAP!
[*] [b]Many more wave types with more enemy quantity![/b] As of last patch, the average enemy count in each wave was 3.4, and now it's 4.05. Various towers that dealt AoE damage have been balanced in result.
[*] [b]Two new maps![/b]
[*] [b]Two new boss trinkets! (Fairy Wand and Sweet Candy)[/b]
[*] [b]You can now change the game speed with hotkeys! (a tooltip with all the existing hotkeys is coming in the future)[/b]
[list]
[*] H: Set game speed to x0.
[*] J: Reduce game speed by x0.5.
[*] K: Increase game speed by x0.5.
[*] L: Set game speed to x2.5.
[/list]
[*] [b]Crit chance now scales with luck for all towers! 1 luck equals 0.33% crit chance.[/b]
[*] Towers that are already placed now have tooltips explaining what they do.
[*] The EXP gained by completing levels and obtaining trinkets has gone up 50%!
[/list]

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
[h3]Trinkets[/h3]
[b]Most of the boss trinkets have been changed to make the decision to pick one or another more interesting.[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ancient Knowledge[/b]: Starting mana 2 -> 3
[*] [b]Bookworm[/b]: Draw one more card each round. Reduce in 1 the maximum overload. -> Draw one more card each round. Lose 6 luck.
[*] [b]Golden Catalyst[/b]: Gold multiplier -75% -> -90%
[*] [b]Heart Catalyst[/b]: Max health lost 4 -> 3
[*] [b]Spell Elixir[/b]: Spell mana 2 -> 3
[/list]

[h3]Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Freezing Fog[/b]: Range 55 -> 65, Slow duration 4 -> 3
[*] [b]Rebound Shock[/b]: Starting magic damage 20 -> 30, Scaling multiplier 10% -> 7.5%
[*] [b]Arcane resonator[/b]: Range (155, 155, 155) -> (170, 170, 170), Fire rate (0.08, 0.24, 0.72) -> (0.12, 0.36, 1.08). Now the tower's fire rate is reduced when it casts many copies of the same spell, up to -90% when copying 12+.
[*] [b]BF Rifle[/b]: Range (130, 140, 150) -> (125, 135, 145)
[*] [b]Ballista[/b]: Range (125, 135, 145) -> (120, 135, 150), Fire rate (1, 1.5, 2) -> (0.8, 1.2, 1.6). Now pierces all enemies since level 1.
[*] [b]Basic Bomber[/b]: Fire rate (0.5, 0.72, 0.94) -> (0.45, 0.65, 0.85), Range (95, 115, 135) -> (95, 110, 125). Taking into account the increased average enemy count, this tower's power level is roughly the same.
[*] [b]Bomber[/b]: Fire rate (0.5, 0.75, 1) -> (0.5, 0.7, 0.9), Range (95, 115, 135) -> (95, 110, 125). Same as the Basic Bomber.
[*] [b]Cremator[/b]: Range (150, 150, 150) -> (155, 155, 155), Fire rate (3.5, 4, 4.5) -> (2.8, 3.2, 3.6). 
[*] [b]Disruptor[/b]: Range (100, 120, 140) -> (110, 120, 130), Fire rate (1.4, 1.5, 1.6) -> (1.75, 2, 2.25), Magic damage (2, 6, 18) -> (1, 3, 9)
[*] [b]Fulminator[/b]: Fire rate (0.24, 0.25, 0.26) -> (0.25, 0.27, 0.29)
[*] [b]Giant's Bane[/b]: Range (130, 140, 150) -> (150, 150, 150)
[*] [b]Isochron Bot[/b]: Range (90, 90, 90) -> (95, 95, 95), Fire rate (0.65, 0.65, 0.65) -> (0.75, 0.75, 0.75)
[*] [b]Ruthless End[/b]: Magic pen (100, 100, 100) -> (400, 400, 400)
[*] [b]Sniper[/b]: Fire rate (0.3, 0.45, 0.6) -> (0.3, 0.4, 0.5)
[*] [b]Virtuoso[/b]: Range (110, 115, 120) -> (120, 125, 130)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Spell mana is no longer spent when casting spells that have reduced costs.
[*] Towers and enemies shouldn't randomly lose mouse focus now.
[*] The Everchanging deck now correctly shows ascension progress in the deck list.
[/list]
